correction_reason: v1.0 described TOPA Spider too much like an external/adjacent subsystem. Canonical TOPA semantics already define TOPA_DETECTIVE_SPIDER as the default operational identity: TOPA CORE + SPIDER. Both capabilities remain independently addressable.

DETECTIVE.meaning: Normal TOPA invocation. Provenance/falsification core and relationship-weaving Spider operate together.

TOPA_CORE_ONLY.meaning: Explicit opt-out from graph weaving; pure TOPA claim/provenance/falsification work.

SPIDER_STANDALONE.meaning: Spider independently collects, connects, ranks and weaves candidate relationships without invoking TOPA CORE.

keymaster_topa_integration.meaning: When Keymaster requests TOPA without an explicit profile, it receives both TOPA CORE scrutiny and SPIDER relationship weaving.
keymaster_topa_integration.note_on_existing_keymaster_pivot_spider_: The dedicated TOPA pivot relation-mining workflow is an explicit SPIDER_STANDALONE-style diagnostic lane. It does not redefine the default TOPA identity. Results entering the default TOPA path must subsequently be exposed to TOPA CORE falsification/calibration.
recommended_flow: 1. Exact JANUS state/receipts enter Keymaster calibration context.
2. SPIDER weaves structural relations across pivot histories, safe/overflow contrasts and champion/anti-champion prefixes.
3. TOPA CORE attacks those relations for replay inflation, unsupported transfer, confounding and provenance defects.
4. DETECTIVE emits surviving hypotheses/counterexample targets to Keymaster and Pivot-Slime.
5. Keymaster ranks top-k candidate pivot actions.
6. Exact JANUS elimination replay alone decides fit/overflow/proof-state semantics.
7. Verified receipt is appended to M2R-PM and becomes new calibration material.
8. Spider may revisit the expanded graph; TOPA CORE again prevents relationship density from becoming truth.
